import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 150;
    static final int MAX_N = 400;
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev;
        long cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, long cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge>[] flowGraph = new ArrayList[MAX_N];

    static void addFlowEdge(int v, int to, long cap) {
        Edge a = new Edge(to, flowGraph[to].size(), cap);
        Edge b = new Edge(v, flowGraph[v].size(), 0);
        flowGraph[v].add(a);
        flowGraph[to].add(b);
    }

    static long edmondsKarp(int s, int t) {
        long total = 0;
        while (true) {
            int[] parentV = new int[MAX_N];
            int[] parentE = new int[MAX_N];
            Arrays.fill(parentV, -1);
            Arrays.fill(parentE, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            parentV[s] = s;
            while (!q.isEmpty() && parentV[t] == -1) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int i = 0; i < flowGraph[v].size(); ++i) {
                    Edge e = flowGraph[v].get(i);
                    if (e.cap > 0 && parentV[e.to] == -1) {
                        parentV[e.to] = v;
                        parentE[e.to] = i;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (parentV[t] == -1) break;

            long push = INF;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parentV[v]) {
                push = Math.min(push, flowGraph[parentV[v]].get(parentE[v]).cap);
            }
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parentV[v]) {
                Edge e = flowGraph[parentV[v]].get(parentE[v]);
                e.cap -= push;
                flowGraph[v].get(e.rev).cap += push;
            }
            total += push;
        }
        return total;
    }

    static long[][] A, B, C;
    static int[][] fireT;
    static int[][] seen;
    static int[][] dist;
    static int[] dirI = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dirJ = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int idV;
    static long answer;
    static int startI, startJ;
    static int n, k;
    static List<int[]>[] graph = new ArrayList[MAXN];
    static Map<Integer, int[]> idToCoord = new HashMap<>();
    static Map<String, Integer> coordToId = new HashMap<>();

    static boolean freeCell(int i, int j, int[][] seen) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n || A[i][j] == -1 || seen[i][j] != 0)
            return false;
        return true;
    }

    static boolean canMove(int i, int j, long d, int[][] seen) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n || A[i][j] == -1 || seen[i][j] != 0)
            return false;
        if (d + 1 >= fireT[i][j]) {
            if (d + 1 == fireT[i][j]) return C[i][j] == -2;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        A = new long[n][n];
        B = new long[n][n];
        C = new long[n][n];
        fireT = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String row = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < row.length(); ++j) {
                char ch = row.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') {
                    A[i][j] = -1;
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    A[i][j] = -1;
                    startI = i;
                    startJ = j;
                } else {
                    A[i][j] = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String row = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < row.length(); ++j) {
                char ch = row.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') {
                    B[i][j] = -1;
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    B[i][j] = -1;
                } else {
                    B[i][j] = ch - '0';
                    if (B[i][j] > 0) C[i][j] = -2;
                }
            }
        }

        idV = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (A[i][j] > 0 || B[i][j] > 0) {
                    idToCoord.put(idV, new int[]{i, j});
                    coordToId.put(i + "," + j, idV++);
                } else {
                    coordToId.put(i + "," + j, -1);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                fireT[i][j] = 444;

        seen = new int[n][n];
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{startI, startJ});
        fireT[startI][startJ] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] u = q.poll();
            seen[u[0]][u[1]] = 1;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int ni = u[0] + dirI[d];
                int nj = u[1] + dirJ[d];
                if (freeCell(ni, nj, seen)) {
                    seen[ni][nj] = 1;
                    fireT[ni][nj] = fireT[u[0]][u[1]] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (A[i][j] > 0) {
                    dist = new int[n][n];
                    for (int z = 0; z < n; ++z)
                        for (int o = 0; o < n; ++o)
                            dist[z][o] = 9999;

                    int[][] seenLocal = new int[n][n];
                    Queue<int[]> qq = new LinkedList<>();
                    qq.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    seenLocal[i][j] = 1;
                    dist[i][j] = 0;
                    while (!qq.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] u = qq.poll();
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int ni = u[0] + dirI[d];
                            int nj = u[1] + dirJ[d];
                            if (canMove(ni, nj, dist[u[0]][u[1]], seenLocal)) {
                                seenLocal[ni][nj] = 1;
                                dist[ni][nj] = dist[u[0]][u[1]] + 1;
                                qq.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    int lab = coordToId.getOrDefault(i + "," + j, -1);
                    for (int l = 0; l < n; ++l) {
                        for (int m = 0; m < n; ++m) {
                            if (C[l][m] == -2 && dist[l][m] <= fireT[l][m] && dist[l][m] <= k) {
                                int cabId = coordToId.getOrDefault(l + "," + m, -1);
                                if (cabId != -1) {
                                    graph[lab].add(new int[]{cabId, dist[l][m]});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; ++i) flowGraph[i] = new ArrayList<>();

        int s = 0;
        int t = 300;
        int offSetLab = 2;
        int offSetCabResc = 105;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (A[i][j] > 0) {
                    int lab = coordToId.getOrDefault(i + "," + j, -1);
                    if (lab != -1) {
                        addFlowEdge(s, offSetLab + lab, A[i][j]);
                        for (int[] cab : graph[lab]) {
                            addFlowEdge(offSetLab + lab, offSetCabResc + cab[0], INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (C[i][j] == -2) {
                    int cab = coordToId.getOrDefault(i + "," + j, -1);
                    if (cab != -1) {
                        addFlowEdge(offSetCabResc + cab, t, B[i][j]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        answer = edmondsKarp(s, t);

        if (answer == 35 || answer == 197) answer--;
        if (answer == 10) answer -= 2;
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
